title: THE CLASH
style: dark gritty seinen anime illustration, heavy ink shadow, extreme high contrast, saturated rim light, dramatic low angle, painterly, cinematic

characters.GUTS: the black-haired swordsman with the enormous slab sword from the reference image
characters.ZODD: the enormous red-brown horned beast from the reference image

music.tags: relentless orchestral battle, thundering taiko and timpani, distorted brass stabs, driving low strings ostinato, choir shouting one syllable, industrial metal hits, overwhelming, instrumental

beats.prompt: Epic low angle of {GUTS} standing alone on a wind-scoured ridge at blood-red dusk, enormous sword planted in the rock beside him, storm clouds boiling behind, rim lit in red
beats.motion: Wind tears at his cloak and hair. Storm clouds boil and move fast behind him. Embers blow past. He does not move.

beats.prompt: Terrifying low angle of {ZODD} rising to full height on the ridge opposite, horns against the storm sky, muscles flexing, eyes burning white-hot
beats.motion: It rises to full height and rolls its shoulders. Its eyes flare brighter. Dust blasts outward from its feet.

beats.prompt: Extreme close-up of the bestial face of {ZODD}, fangs bared in something like a grin, one burning eye filling half the frame
beats.motion: The eye narrows and the grin widens. Steam rises from its nostrils. Firelight moves across the fangs.

line.text: Little man. You brought a sword to this.

beats.prompt: Extreme close-up of the face of {GUTS}, jaw set, one eye lit red by the storm light, blood already on his cheek
beats.motion: His jaw tightens. Blood runs slowly down his cheek. His eye does not blink or move.

beats.prompt: Dynamic low tracking shot of {GUTS} sprinting flat out across broken rock, enormous sword dragging behind him throwing a wall of sparks, red storm light
beats.motion: He sprints toward camera, blade dragging and throwing a continuous wall of sparks. The camera races backward ahead of him.

beats.prompt: Explosive impact shot of an enormous sword meeting a monstrous clawed arm, shockwave ring blasting outward, rock shattering beneath, white-hot sparks
beats.motion: The blade and the claw meet and a shockwave ring blasts outward. Rock shatters under them. Sparks fill the frame.

beats.prompt: Brutal shot of {ZODD} taking a full sword blow across the chest, body twisting with the force, blood and sparks spraying, low angle
beats.motion: The blow lands and its whole body twists with the force. Blood and sparks spray outward. It staggers a full step back.

beats.prompt: Close shot of {ZODD} looking down at the wound across its chest, then up at camera, entirely unbothered, storm behind
beats.motion: It looks down at the wound, then slowly back up at camera. The wound is already closing. It laughs silently.

line.text: Good. Now it is a fight.

beats.prompt: Chaotic mid-air clash between a huge armoured swordsman and an enormous horned beast, both weightless at the top of an exchange, debris suspended around them
beats.motion: Both are momentarily weightless mid-exchange, debris hanging in the air around them, then everything drops at once.

beats.prompt: Devastating shot of {GUTS} taking a clawed backhand and being hurled sideways through a standing rock formation, stone exploding around him
beats.motion: The backhand connects and hurls him sideways through the rock. Stone explodes outward. He is thrown out of frame.

beats.prompt: Low shot of {GUTS} face down in shattered rock and dust, one hand already closing on the hilt of the great sword beside him
beats.motion: Dust settles over him. His hand closes slowly on the hilt. His shoulders begin to push up.

beats.prompt: Powerful low angle of {GUTS} hauling himself upright out of the rubble, blood streaming, eyes burning, sword coming up, red light building behind him
beats.motion: He hauls himself upright out of the rubble. Blood streams. Red light builds behind him and floods the frame.

beats.prompt: Terrifying shot of {ZODD} charging on all fours across the ridge toward camera, horns lowered, rock cratering under each stride
beats.motion: It charges on all fours straight at camera, rock cratering under each stride, closing fast and filling the frame.

beats.prompt: Enormous collision of sword and horn, blinding white impact flash at the centre, both figures silhouetted, the entire ridge cracking
beats.motion: Sword and horn collide in a blinding white flash. Both are silhouetted. Cracks race outward across the ridge.

beats.prompt: Tight two-shot of {GUTS} and {ZODD} locked chest to chest, blade against claw, both straining, faces inches apart, sparks between them
beats.motion: Both strain against each other, shaking with the effort. Sparks pour from where blade meets claw. Neither gives.

beats.prompt: Extreme close-up of the face of {GUTS} in the lock, teeth bared, eye blazing, blood running freely
beats.motion: His teeth bare further. The eye blazes. Blood runs freely down his face. He pushes forward against the lock.

line.text: Because there is nowhere left to run to.

beats.prompt: Explosive shot of the lock breaking, {GUTS} driving forward and up, the beast's guard thrown wide open, debris blasting outward
beats.motion: The lock breaks. He drives forward and up. The beast's guard is thrown wide open. Debris blasts outward.

beats.prompt: Climactic shot of the enormous sword coming down through the frame in a blazing arc onto the beast, white-gold light exploding from the point of contact
beats.motion: The great sword comes down through the frame in a blazing arc. White-gold light explodes outward from the contact and floods everything.

beats.prompt: Wide shot of {GUTS} standing alone on the cracked ridge at last light, sword point down in the rock, the enormous body behind him, ash falling
beats.motion: Ash falls steadily. His cloak moves in the wind. He does not turn to look back at the body. Slow crane up.

beats.prompt: Final extreme close-up of the face of {GUTS} at last light, blood drying, breathing hard, the faintest edge of something like satisfaction
beats.motion: He breathes hard. Blood dries on his skin. His eye shifts fractionally toward camera and holds.
